scope: toggle-scoped, NOT era-scoped: shown only while the layer chip is on, identical in every era; era legends (db/legends/eras/*.json) are unchanged

toggles.note_en: Below 0 m clamps to the first stop; 4,500 m and above clamp to the last.
toggles.note_ar: ما دون 0 م يأخذ اللون الأول، وما فوق 4500 م يأخذ اللون الأخير [يحتاج تحقق]
toggles.drawn_status: MISMATCH at site working tree (Web Lead map.js, uncommitted): the 'dem' chip draws Esri World_Hillshade tiles (grey relief, no elevation colour). This bar is valid only once the dem_ramp tint is drawn; until then the legend must show the hillshade row (map.js lsw.hs, 'Hillshade from elevation model (Esri World Hillshade)') and NOT this bar.

toggles.label_en: Density of mapped battle locations (relative, no units)
toggles.label_ar: كثافة مواقع المعارك المرسومة (نسبية، بلا وحدات) [يحتاج تحقق]
toggles.counts: battles in /b.json that have coordinates (b.ll non-null), each weighted equally (one kernel, radius 18px*sqrt(zoom)); ev/ events are NOT included (no coordinates). Not filtered by era. Normalised to the densest spot in the current view, so 1 = local maximum, not an absolute count.
toggles.note_en: Battles with known coordinates only; scale re-normalised to the current view. Reported 2023+ clashes are not a measure of control or intensity.
toggles.note_ar: المعارك ذات الإحداثيات المعروفة فقط؛ يُعاد ضبط المقياس حسب العرض الحالي. الاشتباكات المُبلغ عنها منذ 2023 ليست مقياسًا للسيطرة أو الشدة [يحتاج تحقق]
toggles.drawn_status: matches site working tree heatDraw() (HRAMP = heatmap_ramp, opacity .75)
